children: Luxury companies should expect continued soft demand in China, Berenberg analysts say. The country is facing high levels of debt and a sustained fall in asset prices, in addition to other headwinds, the analysts write in a research note. "We expect Chinese data to continue to disappoint more often than not," Berenberg says. This matters as both consensus and companies still expect the Chinese consumer to be a key driver of global growth into the 2030s, they add. Furthermore, European luxury companies are grappling with higher competition in the market as Chinese brands continue to rise, Berenberg says. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
